newsitem.title: UK: ICI shares up in strong chemical sector.
newsitem.headline: ICI shares up in strong chemical sector.

text.p: Shares in Imperial Chemical Industries Plc rose to a three-month high on Tuesday as renewed interest in some cyclical stocks met a shortage of stock in the market, traders said.
ICI shares were up 16-1/2p at 856-1/2 by 1417 GMT, after earlier rising as high as 860 -- the highest since early June.

Traders said ICI had also been boosted by recent news from second-line chemical stocks, with British Vita Plc yesterday pledging to aim to improve profit margins amid signs of improving demand in continental Europe.
"The chemical sector is looking interesting and people are looking to move into cyclical stocks," said one sales trader.
British Vita was up 4-1/2p at 239-1/2 while among other chemical stocks Laporte Plc was up 14p at 755, Courtaulds Plc was up 5-1/2p at 445 and Albright & Wilson Plc was up 8-1/2p at 205.
